title: The Black Hole Bomb and Black Hole Civilizations
beats: Black holes devour energy forever, or do they? A universe cheat code for power or a bomb
Restates the belief that all energy is trapped, confirms it, then promises it gets weirder because black holes spin
Massive star cores collapse into black holes, big becomes tiny
Angular momentum: spinning things resist stopping; shrinking makes them spin faster, so black holes spin millions of times a second
Singularity as a point cannot rotate, so it must be a ring: the ringularity
Spacetime dragged; ergosphere as half-broken space between normal and fully broken inside the horizon
Static hole is a slide down a hole; ergosphere is a spiral down a deadly drain
Cheat code: steal the rotational energy; Milky Way's central hole holds a billion years of stars' output
Whirlpool: a clever swimmer uses the water to swim faster
Rocket trade (Penrose process): push in a pool vs push in a wave pool; you leave with more energy than you entered
Future civilization feeds asteroids to the hole to harvest
Black hole bomb: spinning hole plus enveloping mirror, comparison to Dyson sphere, 10 cm asteroid-metal shell
Ball thrown at a wall that returns faster than a bullet
Superradiant scattering defined as bouncing between mirror and hole, growing exponentially
Open windows for endless energy, or keep closed until the mirror shatters, supernova-scale
Not science fiction; in a dying universe rotating holes may be the last energy source
Closing line: even without light there are places to go

metrics.misconception: yes: all energy is trapped in black holes (0:18)

metrics.ending: Chilling and uplifting last-being scene with a short hopeful line

new_moves.name: analogy-ladder
new_moves.what: Chain several analogies of rising fidelity for one mechanism (slide, drain, whirlpool, pool then wave pool) rather than reusing one

new_moves.name: cheat-code-frame
new_moves.what: Name the payoff as a game cheat code up front, then present each step as how to exploit it

new_moves.name: derive-the-weird-name
new_moves.what: Justify a strange term by a short logical contradiction (points cannot rotate), then name it with a pun

theory: The video never lets an abstract step stand without a physical stand-in, and upgrades the stand-in as the physics gets more specific (drain, whirlpool, wave pool). A cheat-code framing gives the viewer a goal to pursue so each fact has a job. Terms arrive last, as labels for something the viewer has already pictured.
velocity: Scene builder: support an analogy chain where the same object (water, pool) morphs to match each new physical step
Voice: place the technical term after the analogy lands, with a one-line plain gloss
Orchestrator: open with a goal frame (cheat code) so each beat is purposeful
Evals: check each new term is preceded by a visual stand-in within 30 seconds
quote: it's like pushing yourself forward in a wave pool
